user.title: Connect to mailroom
user.description: Enter the address of the mailroom dashboard, including any base path. For example: {example_url}

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure mailroom
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address of the mailroom dashboard, including any base path. For example: {example_url}

error.invalid_url: Enter an http:// or https:// URL without a query string.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to mailroom at that address.
error.invalid_response: Something answered at that address, but it does not look like mailroom.

abort.already_configured: This mailroom instance is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The mailroom address has been updated.

add_parcel.name: Add parcel
add_parcel.description: Files a new parcel in mailroom, on its way. Fails if mailroom already has a parcel with that tracking number.

config_entry_id.name: Mailroom instance
config_entry_id.description: The mailroom to use. Only needed when more than one is set up.

tracking_number.name: Tracking number
tracking_number.description: The tracking number of the parcel. Letters, digits, '-' and '_' only.

carrier.name: Carrier
carrier.description: The carrier, or the id mailroom knows it by if it is not listed. Without one mailroom cannot poll the parcel.

postcode.name: Postcode
postcode.description: The delivery postcode. DPD and PostNL need it to look a parcel up.

refresh_parcel.name: Refresh parcel
refresh_parcel.description: Has mailroom ask the carrier about a parcel now rather than at its next polling round. Returns mailroom's outcome and the parcel's record.

config_entry_id.name: Mailroom instance
config_entry_id.description: The mailroom to use. Only needed when more than one is set up.

tracking_number.name: Tracking number
tracking_number.description: The tracking number of the parcel to refresh.

remove_parcel.name: Remove parcel
remove_parcel.description: Deletes a parcel's record from mailroom, including its history.

config_entry_id.name: Mailroom instance
config_entry_id.description: The mailroom to use. Only needed when more than one is set up.

tracking_number.name: Tracking number
tracking_number.description: The tracking number of the parcel to remove.
